name: Charizard Statue
description: A Charizard minecraft statue in orange blocks with a white belly and wings built from fences and rails. Stands on four legs with a stepped tail. Mostly orange concrete plus fences, so it comes together fast. Set it near your base as a landmark for Pokemon fans.
